gate_rule.clearly_underperforms (stop): gate checkpoint paired diff vs zero <= -5 pp, or diff < 0 with exact McNemar p < 0.05
gate_rule.25k_continue: diff >= 0 AND episodes fixed by the residual (only residual succeeds) >= 3 AND > the number fixed by the chaos control
gate_rule.25k_otherwise: stop (comparable but no evidence of useful corrections beyond chaos)
gate_rule.50k_continue_to_75k: diff > 0 AND fixed >= 3 AND fixed > chaos control AND diff(50k) >= diff(25k); otherwise stop at 50k
